Product Title:
SmartFit Pro X1 Smartwatch

Short Marketing Description:
Stay connected, active, and in control with the SmartFit Pro X1 Smartwatch. Featuring a vibrant 1.9-inch AMOLED display, Bluetooth calling, advanced health monitoring, and up to 7 days of battery life, it is designed to support your lifestyle every day.

Key Features:
- 1.9-inch AMOLED high-resolution display
- Bluetooth calling for seamless communication
- Up to 7-day battery life
- Real-time heart-rate monitoring
- Advanced sleep tracking insights
- IP68 waterproof protection
- Comprehensive fitness activity tracking

Promotional Tagline:
Smart health. Smart style. Smart living.
